text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to stand out in her debut race,<n>Shinko Windy
decides to create a<n>promotional video to boost the
popularity of dirt racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the advice of her friends,<n>she goes to
negotiate with the<n>student council to see if the
academy<n>might officially publish the video.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, all the council members<n>are absent.
Just then, the aspiring<n>hero Biko Pegasus shows
up and<n>finds Shinko Windy's behavior<n>suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the misunderstanding is<n>cleared up, Biko
Pegasus declares<n>that she won't overlook any
villainous deeds. Shinko Windy is<n>overjoyed at the
attention this<n>implies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them may very well face<n>off on the track
someday.
